resolution: Built the FULLRES residency vertical end to end: the /editor route now loads the WHOLE cooked-asset catalog into the loader as resident meshes on entry (and on any cooked-catalog change), so every Studio-compiled asset is placeable/movable/rotatable/deletable/skinnable INSTANTLY off the live-ref path with zero world rebake — killing the compile/debounce gymnastics in the edit loop. Layers: JS buildResidentMeshCatalogLump() encodes the full cooked catalog as a MESH_PROPS lump via the existing cookedPropMesh+encodeMeshProps; LoaderIsoView pushes it via the new __compiled_world_set_resident_meshes door on mount + on cooked-asset changes; the loader (setResidentMeshes/applyResidentMeshes) decodes once per generation with the SAME decodeMeshProps the gamefile uses (so textures/slots/doors come through identically), and meshForHash resolves a live ref against baked meshes THEN the resident catalog, so a never-baked asset draws — appendLiveMeshRef, the placement ghost, and the reskin path all route through it. The lean baked artifact stays the /compiled ship path; Compile leaves the edit loop. Correctness link verified in source: a placement ref hashes fnv1aHash(asset.meshRef) and residency keys liveMeshHash(asset.meshRef) — same key, same FNV-1a. Proof: framework compiles ReleaseFast, the streaming world render proof stays GREEN (rjit game shot), and the MESH_PROPS v7 round-trip suite passes. Live by-feel verification (Studio compile->install, enter /editor, place/move/flip/delete/skin instantly) needs a dev-host restart since Zig changed.
